spells/natural-weapon-augmentation-perso.name: Natural Weapon Augmentation, Personal
spells/natural-weapon-augmentation-perso.effectSummary: For 1 minute per caster level, one of your natural weapons gains one magic-weapon special ability whose market price is equivalent to a +1 bonus or whose flat market-price addition is no more than 10,000 gp. The natural weapon need not already have an enhancement bonus, and this infusion does not grant one. The referenced Dungeon Master's Guide 3.5 melee-weapon table includes the +1-equivalent abilities listed below; keen applies only to a piercing or slashing natural weapon. The spell's printed choice remains open to any other special ability that independently satisfies its +1-equivalent or 10,000-gp-or-less criterion and that is compatible with the natural weapon. The material component is a cinder from a fire put out by rain. Warforged spellcasters cast this infusion at +1 caster level.
spells/natural-weapon-augmentation-perso.notes: Source-locked to Races of Eberron p. 189. The primary spell text is not truncated; the repair-lane signal comes from its explicit delegation to DMG Table 7-14. The restored table is limited to the core +1-equivalent entries and does not narrow the spell's separate printed allowance for qualifying flat-price abilities.
